message.abstract: <jats:title>Key Points</jats:title><jats:p>EGFL7 promotes angiogenesis via its interaction with integrin αvβ3. EGFL7 is involved in physiological and pathological angiogenesis.</jats:p>
title: EGFL7 ligates αvβ3 integrin to enhance vessel formation
